has_group_permission.signature: has_group_permission(gid uuid, perm_key text, uid uuid DEFAULT auth.uid())
has_group_permission.current_admin_fallback: 1) find membership by group+user (any status). 2) owner → TRUE. 3) count open position_assignments for membership. 4) admin AND count=0 → TRUE (full bypass). 5) else TRUE only if open assignment position has perm_key. No status. No same-group gp join.
has_group_permission.target_admin_fallback: Identical steps AFTER requiring membership_status=active. Position path must JOIN group_positions gp ON gp.id=pa.position_id AND gp.group_id=gid. Do NOT grant all-permissions to admin-with-assignments. Owner/admin-zero-assignment bypass preserved.
